notes.content:
[h2]Dear Players,[/h2]

Hello to all of you who adore married ladies!

We sincerely appreciate your constant support and encouragement! We’ve heard all your feedback, but since our team is relatively small, we can’t respond to every suggestion in the forum. Rest assured, we’ll do our best to enhance your gaming experience with each update.

We’re sharing our second development log to give you a better picture of our current progress and future plans. We hope this helps you understand our direction more deeply!

[h2]Currently in Development[/h2]

[h3]Richer Wardrobe Options in Progress[/h3]
We’re designing more interchangeable outfits for the characters, plus adding more sex animations to make interactive scenes even more captivating.

[h3]More Maps to Explore[/h3]
A street and park are in the works, so you’ll soon be able to take a stroll, soak up some sun, and maybe even unlock some special activities at the park after dark.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914065/72896d1c446bbabb9393b83d7bf72785319899c3.png[/img]

[h2]Features Under Research and Testing[/h2] [h3]All-New Gameplay[/h3] We’re testing a new mechanic—“Exhibition Training”—to bring you a richer gaming experience. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914065/0df51ed9c528fc12536b2b721097b14f2307c4e7.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914065/5f15c44ee26268f562569b265a050f112680ef18.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914065/c3f7c4db70c353b04134c7bf2d96cd57124d38ff.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914065/2b02206efb31fe7d019603f89cad731c44be204a.png[/img]

[h3]Character Customization[/h3] We want players to be able to customize characters’ body, details (like genital styles), outfit coordination, and other appearance options so everyone can create characters they truly love. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914065/859117b7ec11c0aaaa676a1bd6ee51d8c27af271.png[/img]

[h2]Ongoing Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Sound Adjustments and Enhancements for Intimate Mode[/h3]
We’re continuously refining the audio so interactive scenes feel even more lively.

[h3]More Realistic Movements[/h3]
We’re updating older, less natural animations so that in-game NPCs come to life more convincingly.

[h3]Improved Lighting and Shadows[/h3]
We’re experimenting with more natural lighting on character models and rolling those updates into the game.

[h3]Puppet System[/h3]
Right now, the Puppet System is only implemented in the intimate mode. It’s more challenging to integrate into the sex mode, but we’re working hard to overcome those technical hurdles. Once we do, we’ll add it to sex mode as well.

[h3]More Realistic Physics and Fluids[/h3]
Our team continues to invest efforts in creating more realistic jiggle physics and fluid effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914065/a57053e4b610a609698b9fc3206671c3e758a1e2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914065/d73b3c4a046cbf945099fb037049e6be80ff826d.gif[/img]

[h3]Performance Optimization[/h3]
As the game expands, it requires more resources. We understand performance needs improvement. This is our first larger-scale project, and we’ll keep working to optimize performance and ease hardware load.

[h3]More Language Support[/h3]
We’re incredibly grateful for the worldwide support. We aim to introduce more languages as we go. Given the growing volume of text and our limited manpower, we plan to use AI translation followed by human editing for gradual multilingual support.

[h3]Section View Feature[/h3] As we add more character details, section view will serve as straightforward visual aids—stay tuned!

That wraps up this edition of our Development Log. Thank you again for your support and patience! We know the game still has plenty of room for improvement, but your feedback and enthusiasm keep us moving forward.

We’ll keep working hard to deliver richer and more exciting content. If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please continue to share them in the forum. We’ll read them all carefully and incorporate them into our development plans!

Sincerely, The Development Team

[h2][b]Dear Players[/b][/h2]  
Hello to all our Steam players!  
First of all, we want to sincerely thank you for your support and enthusiasm. Our development team has been closely monitoring every comment in the discussion forums. While we’re unable to reply to every message due to manpower and language limitations, rest assured that we’re carefully organizing your feedback and using it as a key reference for future updates and improvements.  

To keep you updated on our progress and plans, we’ll be sharing a monthly *Development Journal* on Steam. This will give you a closer look at the game’s growth and development journey—we hope you’ll feel even more connected to it!  

[h2][b]Current and Upcoming Updates[/b][/h2]  

[h3]New Main Storyline: The Bar Proprietress[/h3]  
Following Kaelin’s main storyline, the Bar Proprietress’s story will soon be added to the game. Players will also have three appearance options to choose from at the start of this storyline.

Challenge the women at the Bar to a fun drinking game to test your “alcohol tolerance.” Succeed, and you’ll unlock special interactions (just as you might imagine).  

[h3]Difficulty Options[/h3]  
To cater to different playstyles, we’ll introduce multiple difficulty settings so everyone can enjoy the game at their own pace.  

[h3]More Customizable Outfits[/h3]  
We’re designing more outfits for characters and adding more intimate animations to make interaction scenes even more engaging.  

[h3]Character Customization Features[/h3]  
You’ll be able to adjust body shapes, details (such as genital styles), and outfit combinations, creating a more personalized gaming experience.  

[h2][b]Ongoing Improvements[/b][/h2]  

[h3]Intimacy Mode Sound Effects[/h3]  
We’re refining the sound effects to make interaction scenes more immersive.  

[h3]Performance Optimization[/h3]  
To improve game performance and reduce the hardware load on your devices, we’re working on optimization.  

[h3]Multilingual Support[/h3]  
To accommodate players worldwide, we’ll gradually introduce machine-translated language support, with ongoing improvements to the final text.  

[h3]Profile Feature[/h3]  
We’re developing a profile feature that will serve as a visual aid for more detailed character customization. Stay tuned!  

[h3]Patrol Outfit Variety[/h3]  
Kaelin’s patrol outfits will become more diverse, allowing players to enjoy different styles for different scenarios.  

That’s all for this month’s *Development Journal*! Once again, thank you for your support and patience. We know there’s always room for improvement, but your suggestions and passion are what drive us forward.  

In the future, we’ll keep working hard to bring you a richer and more exciting gaming experience. If you have any thoughts or suggestions, please keep sharing them in the discussion forums—we’ll continue to read them carefully and incorporate them into our development plans!  

Sincerely,  
The Development Team
